name: D-apiitol to nitrate
summary: A 16-step route from D-apiitol to nitrate, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: (carboxyethyl)arginine beta-lactam-synthase
reactions.equation: N(2)-(2-carboxyethyl)-L-arginine + ATP = deoxyamidinoproclavaminate + AMP + diphosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: clavaminate synthase
reactions.equation: proclavaminate + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = dihydroclavaminate + succinate + CO2 + H2O

reactions.name: clavaminate synthase
reactions.equation: dihydroclavaminate + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = clavaminate + succinate + CO2 + H2O

reactions.name: nitrate reductase [NAD(P)H]
reactions.equation: nitrite + NADP(+) + H2O = nitrate + NADPH + H(+)

reactions.name: trans,polycis-polyprenyl diphosphate synthase [(2Z,6E)-farnesyl
reactions.equation: (2Z,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate + 11 isopentenyl diphosphate = di-trans,undeca-cis-tetradecaprenyl diphosphate + 11 diphosphate

reactions.name: tritrans,polycis-undecaprenyl-diphosphate synthase [geranylgeranyl-
reactions.equation: geranylgeranyl diphosphate + 7 isopentenyl diphosphate = tri-trans,hepta-cis-undecaprenyl diphosphate + 7 diphosphate

reactions.name: hypoxia-inducible factor-asparagine dioxygenase
reactions.equation: L-asparaginyl-[hypoxia-inducible factor alpha subunit] + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-asparaginyl-[hypoxia-inducible factor alpha subunit] + succinate + CO2

reactions.name: ankyrin-repeat-histidine dioxagenase
reactions.equation: L-asparaginyl-[ankyrin-repeat domain protein] + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-asparaginyl-[ankyrin-repeat domain protein] + succinate + CO2

reactions.name: 4-nitrophenol 4-monooxygenase
reactions.equation: 4-nitrophenol + NADPH + O2 + H(+) = 1,4-benzoquinone + nitrite + NADP(+) + H2O

reactions.name: hydroxylamine dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: hydroxylamine + 4 Fe(III)-[cytochrome c] + H2O = 4 Fe(II)-[cytochrome c] + nitrite + 5 H(+)

reactions.name: D-octopine dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: D-octopine + NAD(+) + H2O = L-arginine + pyruvate + NADH + H(+)

reactions.name: heptaprenyl diphosphate synthase
reactions.equation: 4 isopentenyl diphosphate + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = all-trans-heptaprenyl diphosphate + 4 diphosphate

reactions.name: all-trans-octaprenyl-diphosphate synthase
reactions.equation: 5 isopentenyl diphosphate + (2E,6E)-farnesyl diphosphate = all-trans-octaprenyl diphosphate + 5 diphosphate

reactions.name: ankyrin-repeat-histidine dioxagenase
reactions.equation: L-aspartyl-[ankyrin-repeat domain protein] + 2-oxoglutarate + O2 = (3S)-3-hydroxy-L-aspartyl-[ankyrin-repeat domain protein] + succinate + CO2

reactions.name: nitroxyl + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome c] + O2 + H(+) = 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome c] + nitrite + H2O
reactions.equation: nitroxyl + 2 Fe(II)-[cytochrome c] + O2 + H(+) = 2 Fe(III)-[cytochrome c] + nitrite + H2O
